changelog: Aura AI v2.4.7 — Advance Browser Voice Control, Hardware Telemetry, Reels/Shorts & Smart YouTube

Full In-Built Browser Voice Control: Wired BrowserMcp DOM tools (browser_read_page, browser_find, browser_click, browser_type, browser_scroll, browser_navigate, browser_tabs, browser_media_control) and unified screen routing with DomainNormalizer + single-load fix

Advance Device Control: Instant fast-path hardware telemetry (battery, volume streams, RAM, storage, network, brightness) and multi-stream volume, ringer mode, DND, torch callback, Quick Settings/panels, and OTP/notification reader
Bulletproof Reels & Shorts Swiping: Safe mid-viewport 0.60h->0.20h awaited gesture, YouTube Shorts detection, fixed direction inversion, and unthrottled UI change observer
Universal UI & Chrome Popups: Multi-window accessibility tree scanning, icon/Hinglish synonyms (3 dots, incognito), fixed ordinal #3 collision, and early abort on failed workflow steps

YouTube Smart Playback & Ad Skip: Zero-quota direct video resolver, curated surprise song playback, modern Litho video picker, youtube_action (skip_ad, like, subscribe, fullscreen) and auto ad-skip watcher
Voice Screen & 60 FPS Smoothness: Repositioned orb/buttons, WebGL orb shader/DOM optimizations, Compose recomposition cleanup, and deferred accessibility IPC
